full_prompt_en: A square painterly portrait shows an older man in oversized amber goggles against a scratched teal-blue wall. His head and shoulders fill most of the frame, and he turns slightly toward the image left with a tight, unsmiling mouth. Short pale hair rises in uneven tufts above a broad lined forehead. The goggles dominate the middle of the picture: thick weathered dark frames surround warm brown-orange lenses, with a slim strap running behind the visible ear. The lenses are translucent enough to suggest darkness behind them, yet the eyes themselves remain unclear. Deep creases cut across the forehead, around the nose, and down the cheeks. The nose and lips are modeled in warm peach and muted rose, while cooler violet-blue shadow shapes mark the jaw and the side of the neck. A heavy olive and khaki outer garment wraps around the shoulders, with a raised collar, seams, and a broad textured strap at the lower left. Behind him, the flat wall bears vertical scratches, faint rectangular marks, and rubbed patches that give it a worn industrial texture without describing a full location. The image is tightly cropped, so neither his hands nor the rest of the outfit are visible. Small directional strokes describe hair and facial planes, while broader rough strokes build the wall and fabric. Light falls from above and the image left, brightening the forehead, nose, and top edges of the goggles; stronger shadow gathers beneath the frames and collar. The overall composition contrasts warm amber glass and flesh with cool teal surroundings, making the stern face feel weathered and resolute.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形绘画式肖像呈现一位戴着宽大琥珀色护目镜的年长男子，背景是一面带划痕的青蓝墙。他的头肩填满画面大部，略向左侧转，嘴紧闭且不笑。短浅色头发在宽阔、有纹路的额头上方不均匀地翘起。护目镜主导画面中部：厚而磨旧的深色镜框围住暖棕橙镜片，一条细带绕过可见的耳朵。镜片略有透光，暗示其后有暗部，但眼睛本身看不清。深皱纹横过额头、鼻旁并向面颊延伸。鼻子和嘴唇以暖桃色、柔玫瑰色塑造，冷紫蓝影形标出下颌与颈侧。厚重的橄榄与卡其色外衣包住肩膀，带竖起的领子、缝线，左下还可见宽厚织纹背带。身后平墙有竖划痕、隐约方形线和磨擦色斑，形成旧工业质感，却没有交代完整地点。画面裁切很紧，双手与其余衣物都不可见。细小定向笔触描述头发与面部平面，较宽粗笔触构成墙壁与衣料。光从上方和画面左侧落下，照亮额头、鼻子和护目镜上缘；镜框与领子下方聚起更深阴影。整体构图以暖琥珀镜片和肤色对照冷青蓝周围，使严肃面容显得饱经风霜而坚定。
style_prompt_en: The image has a rough painterly finish that combines broad scratched color fields with short directional strokes on focal surfaces. Cool teal and blue dominate the surrounding area, while amber, peach, and muted olive supply compact warm weight. Hard seams and dark framed edges provide structure against scuffed, loosely handled background marks. Color shifts across planes remain visible, with blue-violet shadows set beside warmer highlights instead of a neutral gray model. A high side light catches raised edges and leaves layered shade beneath projecting forms. Tight cropping packs the center with texture, while a simple worn field holds the background. The overall effect is rugged, cinematic, and tactile, with weathering carried by both marks and light.
style_prompt_zh: 画面有粗粝的绘画完成感，将宽阔刮擦色域与焦点表面的短促定向笔触结合。冷青与蓝色主导周围，琥珀、桃色和柔橄榄色提供紧凑的暖色分量。坚硬接缝和深色框状边缘在松散擦磨的背景笔痕前提供结构。形体平面上的色彩转移清晰可见，蓝紫阴影直接与暖亮部相邻，而非用中性灰塑形。高位侧光接住凸起边缘，在突出的形体下方留下层叠阴影。紧密裁切使中央充满肌理，背景则由简单磨旧色域承托。整体效果粗犷、有电影感且可触，磨损同时由笔痕与光线体现。
theme_en: A painterly close portrait of an older man wearing amber goggles against a teal wall
theme_zh: 一位戴琥珀色护目镜的年长男子在青蓝墙前的绘画式近景
name: Tony Scott
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
